message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards applied to incoming data or arguments anywhere in the visible code.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths and flat text files with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks for any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering mechanisms applied to training samples anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads checkpoints and saves models via torch.save/torch.load (save_checkpoint) and joblib.dump without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision mechanism.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or noise-injection mechanism is used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The validation set ('test' mode of COVIDxDataset) is reused each trial without isolation from the HPO loop, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and the single recall_mean metric returned from validation is used directly as the Optuna objective without any independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed before data is passed to the model anywhere in the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (e.g., recall_mean returned from objective) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-based COVID classification model (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
